description: Source code implementing CMAC (Cipher-based Message Authentication Code) functions using OpenSSL, including context management, initialization, update, finalization, and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: cmac_ctx_st
classes.description: Structure representing the CMAC context, including cipher context, subkeys, buffer, and buffer usage.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_init
methods.description: Initializes the CMAC context by initializing the cipher context.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the CMAC context, freeing resources and cleansing sensitive data.

methods.name: AES_CMAC
methods.description: Computes the CMAC of input data using AES with specified key.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new CMAC context.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_copy
methods.description: Copies the state from one CMAC context to another.

methods.name: CMAC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CMAC context with a key and cipher.

methods.name: CMAC_Reset
methods.description: Resets the CMAC context to initial state.

methods.name: CMAC_Update
methods.description: Updates the CMAC with additional input data.

methods.name: CMAC_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the CMAC computation and outputs the result.

methods.name: binary_field_mul_x_128
methods.description: Performs multiplication by x in GF(2^128) on a 128-bit input.

methods.name: binary_field_mul_x_64
methods.description: Performs multiplication by x in GF(2^64) on an 8-byte input.
